Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了，可是有的吃了以后很舒服。他找很多植物。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the first sentence, add a thought to show why the plants interest him: “神农想：这些植物到底有什么用呢？”
2. When describing the painful result, add a physical action to make the feeling vivid: “他捂着肚子，难受得不得了。”

ideas.reason: This adds a fitting thought that explains his interest in the plants.
This adds a concrete reaction that fits the painful result and the story.
